notes.title: Demo Drilling Time!
notes.content:
Attention Drillers!

The Drill Man Rumble Tournament is fast approaching and Drill Warriors from all the tribes are gearing up for the ultimate test of strength!  In preparation for the tournament, we are opening up for a short time and letting you wannabe warriors test your Drill Skills!

https://i.imgur.com/nsiT9My.gif

Drill Man Rumble Demo will be available to play throughout the Steam Game Festival and we hope you enjoy yousevles! If you have time we would love to get your feedback in the Steam Forums, Discord.gg/AI, via email.

We cannot wait to hear your thoughts!


[previewyoutube=zagjuPxxHak;full][/previewyoutube]
